name: Functional - Unsupported LLM Provider Handling
description: Checks that the agent raises a ValueError when an unsupported LLM provider is specified in the environment.
input: Set LLM_PROVIDER environment variable to an unsupported value (e.g., 'unknown'), with other required variables present.
output: ValueError is raised with appropriate error message.
error_scenarios: No exception is raised for unsupported provider
